Brand colour atlas

A visual reference for comparing local identities. Explore the logos, inspect their colour evidence, and place your proposed Burke palette alongside them.

Fresh source audit. Previous research reports and their colour claims are excluded. Artwork comes from company websites, with clearly marked CIREBA directory fallbacks and user-supplied screenshots. Directory samples remain provisional until checked against the company.

All displayed logos and palettes are embedded for offline use. Some light-only logo variants still need supporting identity colours. Source links open online. A sample describes the retrieved asset; it is not an official brand specification. White logo display backgrounds are neutral presentation surfaces.

How to read the evidence

Verified: officially published specification. Extracted: literal paint or CSS value from a first-party digital asset. Sampled: pixel sampled from an image, including approximate screenshot samples. Estimated: visual approximation. Unavailable: no reliable value retrieved. This edition uses Extracted and Sampled values; it does not claim published brand manuals were obtained.

Each colour is labelled with its role and method. Logo colours, image grounds, website backgrounds and supplied screenshot alternatives are kept distinct. A logo may have other legitimate variants. Source pages were checked on 18 October 2026; continuing business operation is not independently certified.
